name: Rithe
source: Rithe is Harth's best friend and next door neighbor, although he is rarely home in the village these days.  Most of his days are spent traveling to neighboring villages with his father to learn more about his family's lucrative jewelry and precious metal venture.  Both sly and cunning, Rithe shows great promise as the heir to the family business.
